description: This file defines the LiteralAILogger class used for logging steps to the LiteralAI observability platform, including methods for batching and sending logs asynchronously and synchronously, and constructing GraphQL queries for logging.

classes.name: LiteralAILogger
classes.description: A logger class for sending logs to the LiteralAI platform, supporting batch processing and asynchronous operations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the logger with API URL, API key, environment, and batch size, setting up HTTP clients and locks.

methods.name: log_success_event
methods.description: Logs a successful event, appending data to the queue and sending batch if threshold is reached.

methods.name: log_failure_event
methods.description: Logs a failed event, appending data to the queue and sending batch if threshold is reached.

methods.name: _send_batch
methods.description: Sends the accumulated log batch to the LiteralAI API via a GraphQL mutation.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a successful event, appending data and flushing queue if needed.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event
methods.description: Asynchronously logs a failed event, appending data and flushing queue if needed.

methods.name: async_send_batch
methods.description: Asynchronously sends the log batch to the API.

methods.name: _prepare_log_data
methods.description: Prepares the log data payload from event details and response.

methods.name: _steps_query_variables_builder
methods.description: Builds GraphQL variables string for the batch of steps.

methods.name: _steps_ingest_steps_builder
methods.description: Builds GraphQL mutation string for ingesting steps.

methods.name: _steps_query_builder
methods.description: Constructs the full GraphQL mutation query for adding steps.

methods.name: _steps_variables_builder
methods.description: Builds a dictionary of variables for the GraphQL mutation.
